review_candidates.description: Description HyerTek is a federal technology consulting firm delivering secure enterprise applications, data analytics, cloud infrastructure, and modernization solutions to federal government agencies. HyerTek is seeking a Senior Azure Cloud & DevSecOps Engineer to design, build, secure, and operate Microsoft Azure environments and the delivery pipelines that deploy into them. The work supports DoW Impact Levels 5, 6, and 7, equivalent classification levels, and other accredited environments as required by the customer. This role owns the full lifecycle, from landing zones, networking, and identity, through hardened container builds, automated security and compliance gates, and controlled releases into Azure Government. A successful candidate will own solutions end to end. You will work directly with cybersecurity professionals, application teams, and Government stakeholders to turn mission requirements and security controls into sound technical designs and production-ready infrastructure and pipelines. Security is built into the platform and pipeline from the start rather than reviewed at the end. You will also automate the technical evidence needed to support and maintain an Authority to Operate (ATO). This role uses approved AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to speed up infrastructure-as-code, pipeline and policy-as-code, findings triage, control documentation, and runbooks. You are expected to apply sound engineering judgment to review and validate all AI-generated output before it is deployed to an accredited environment. Candidates must reside in the Washington, DC, metropolitan area. Some work will be performed at customer facilities, including accredited Secure Areas and SCIFs at Fort Meade. Responsibilities Azure Cloud Build, configure, and maintain secure Microsoft Azure and Azure Government environments supporting IL5, IL6, and IL7 or equivalent workloads, following approved architectures, contract requirements, and applicable security controls. Implement cloud landing zones, subscriptions, resource organization, network boundaries, identity controls, centralized logging, and governance policies. Configure Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, routing, private endpoints, DNS, Azure Firewall, load balancers, NSGs, and hybrid connectivity. Implement identity and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, privileged-access controls, and Azure Key Vault. Deploy and operate Azure compute, storage, database, and container services, including AKS, in line with approved architectures and security requirements. Deploy and operate in disconnected, air-gapped, or classified environments where public-cloud services and external dependencies are limited. DevSecOps and Software Supply Chain Design, maintain, and improve secure CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps across multiple repositories and environments, including air-gapped deployments. Build and maintain hardened containerized applications for Kubernetes platforms such as AKS and OpenShift. Integrate automated security checks into pipelines, covering source code, dependencies, secrets, containers, and infrastructure-as-code. Ensure critical findings are identified, evaluated, and remediated before release. Implement secure artifact management, including SBOMs, artifact signing, provenance attestation, and controlled promotion between environments. Manage secrets and environment-specific configuration using approved vault and configuration-management solutions. Establish reusable pipeline patterns, templates, and automation that keep security and deployment practices consistent across projects. Infrastructure as Code and Automation Deploy and manage Azure infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or comparable IaC tools. Automate cloud operations, compliance validation, and evidence collection using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, or comparable languages. Security, Compliance, and ATO Support Apply Azure Policy, security baselines, DISA STIGs, encryption requirements, and configuration standards in partnership with cybersecurity teams. Implement, validate, and maintain DISA STIGs and security configuration baselines, including remediating findings and automating compliance validation. Automate compliance evidence, configuration monitoring, audit logging, and security reporting in support of RMF authorization, assessment, and continuous ATO activities. Collaborate with cybersecurity and development teams to remediate vulnerabilities, security findings, configuration deviations, and compliance deficiencies. Support security assessments, audits, and customer reviews with accurate configurations, technical documentation, and required evidence. Operations, Reliability, and Documentation Implement monitoring, alerting, audit logging, and dashboards using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Sentinel as applicable. Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, identity, pipeline, container registry, and deployment issues across development, test, and production. Develop, test, and maintain backup, recovery, continuity-of-operations, and disaster-recovery procedures with documented recovery objectives. Produce infrastructure diagrams, configuration documentation, operational runbooks, and customer-handoff materials. Requirements Required Qualifications: 5+ years of hands-on cloud, infrastructure, or DevSecOps engineering experience, including responsibility for production environments and CI/CD pipelines in a regulated or security-sensitive setting. Strong experience designing, deploying, and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure. Hands-on experience with Azure Government or another regulated government-cloud environment. Strong knowledge of Azure networking, identity and access management, compute, storage, security, monitoring, and governance. Experience implementing secure landing zones, subscription structures, network segmentation, access controls, and centralized logging. Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics. Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep/ARM, or a comparable technology. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Enterprise (GitHub Actions, reusable workflows, branch protection, self-hosted runners) and/or Azure DevOps. Production experience with Kubernetes platforms such as AKS or OpenShift, including building secure container images with hardened base images, multi-stage builds, vulnerability scanning, and non-root runtimes. Experience integrating automated security scanning into CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of secure software supply-chain practices, including SBOM generation, artifact signing, and provenance attestation. Demonstrated experience applying DISA STIGs or comparable federal security configuration baselines in cloud or infrastructure environments. Familiarity with the DoW Cloud Computing SRG, RMF, and NIST SP 800-53. Working knowledge of Windows and Linux administration, including command-line troubleshooting and system hardening. Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, or a comparable language. Understanding of least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, backup, and disaster recovery. Demonstrated proficiency using AI-assisted development platforms (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot), with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code and documentation. Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple concurrent engagements. DoW 8140-aligned IAT Level II certification, with Security+ CE or an approved equivalent. Active Top Secret security clearance. Must be eligible to obtain and maintain SCI and any additional customer-specific access requirements. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with Azure Government Secret, Top Secret, or other classified cloud environments. Experience supporting DoW IL5, IL6, or IL7 (or equivalent), ICD 503, JSIG, or SAP workloads. Experience with Azure Landing Zones, Secure Azure Computing Architecture (SACA), or DoW Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA). Experience with hybrid connectivity, ExpressRoute, network virtual appliances, boundary protection, enterprise DNS, or cross-domain solutions. Experience with GitHub Enterprise Server in disconnected or air-gapped environments, and transferring software artifacts into air-gapped or cross-domain environments. Experience with Iron Bank, Platform One, or comparable hardened-container programs. Experience with Kubernetes policy tools such as OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno. Experience automating STIG validation, configuration compliance, or continuous-monitoring evidence pipelines. Experience supporting RMF authorization, remediation, or continuous ATO initiatives. Experience with production secrets rotation, SIEM integration, and audit-log retention. Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert. CISSP, CASP+, or another advanced security certification Benefits HyerTek offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with employer contribution Paid time off (PTO) and company holidays Professional development and certification support Employee assistance program (EAP) Life and disability insurance Clerance and Work Authorization This position requires U.S. citizenship and an active TS security clearance with the Department of War. The position supports systems operating across unclassified and authorized classified environments, including the Defense Research and Engineering Network (DREN), associated enclaves, and standalone systems. The Linux System Administrator will collaborate with Linux and Windows support technicians, cybersecurity personnel, enterprise administrators, and government scientists and engineers to ensure reliable, secure, and effective computing services in support of the RDL research mission. Since 1976, SMS has specialized in modernizing legacy IT and sustaining complex enterprise environments for federal agencies. With the goal of building long-term partnerships with our customers, we invest in our employees by providing the training, tools, and support they need to keep critical missions operational, improve performance, and reduce risk. SMS is headquartered in McLean, Virginia, with offices and on-site operations at customer locations throughout the United States. For additional information on SMS, visit www.sms.com. Submit your resume today! Job Responsibilities Linux Systems Administration Install, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux-based servers, scientific workstations, and associated hardware and software within the AFRL/RDL computing environment. Perform operating system lifecycle management, including system deployment, configuration, patching, upgrades, performance monitoring, and preventive maintenance. Administer Linux system services, user accounts, groups, file permissions (POSIX/ACLs), and network file services (NFS/SMB). Diagnose and resolve complex operating system, hardware, application, and performance issues, coordinating with enterprise administrators and vendors as necessary. Develop and maintain Linux shell scripts and automated processes to support system configuration, maintenance, monitoring, and routine administrative tasks. Cybersecurity and Compliance Maintain system security configurations in accordance with applicable DoD, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), Air Force, and AFRL cybersecurity requirements. Perform security patching, system hardening, vulnerability remediation, access control management, and system logging and auditing for assigned Linux systems. Support Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authorization to Operate (ATO), and related cybersecurity accreditation activities through technical documentation, configuration management, and compliance assessments. Scientific Computing and Application Support Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot scientific and engineering applications, development tools, compilers, and associated software licensing services used by AFRL/RDL researchers. Support specialized computing environments, laboratory systems, and research workflows, coordinating with scientists and engineers to resolve technical issues and maintain system functionality. Evaluate and recommend hardware, operating system, software, and infrastructure improvements to support evolving research requirements. Storage, Backup, and Disaster Recovery Administer and maintain storage resources, including local and network storage, RAID configurations, SAN/NAS systems, and associated file-sharing services. Manage and monitor system backups, perform data restoration and recovery operations, and support disaster recovery and continuity of operations planning and testing. Network and Systems Integration Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux system connectivity across authorized enterprise, research, and isolated computing environments, including DREN, designated enclaves, and standalone systems. Coordinate with Windows, network, and cybersecurity administrators to support cross-platform integration, network services, secure connectivity, and resolution of complex infrastructure issues. Provide Linux system administration and operational support for authorized classified computing environments in accordance with applicable security requirements and system access authorizations. Documentation, Coordination, and Technical Support Create, maintain, and update system documentation, configuration baselines, operating procedures, maintenance records, and technical information supporting cybersecurity compliance and continuity of operations. Provide advanced technical troubleshooting and escalation support for Linux-related incidents and service requests, collaborating with the RDL Linux Technician and other support personnel to ensure timely resolution. Coordinate with enterprise support organizations, government personnel, and other technical teams to support system maintenance, planned changes, integration activities, and continued availability of mission-critical computing resources. Required Qualifications Must possess or be able to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret Security Clearance, with the ability to meet all security and access requirements associated with assigned systems. Must possess a current DoD-approved Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level II certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE) by the first day of work and maintain certification throughout employment. Minimum of 3 years of hands-on Linux system administration experience in an enterprise, government, or similarly complex computing environment. Working knowledge of Linux operating system administration, including user and group management, file permissions, system services, package management, patching, and system performance troubleshooting. Experience with Linux networking and storage technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, NFS/SMB, RAID, and local or network-attached storage. Experience with Linux shell scripting (Bash or equivalent) for system administration, troubleshooting, and task automation. Working knowledge of system security practices, including operating system hardening, vulnerability remediation, access controls, and security patch management. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical problems and effectively communicate with technical personnel and end users. Desired Qualifications Current Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), or other relevant Linux administration certification. Experience supporting Linux-based scientific computing environments, research laboratories, or engineering organizations. Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity requirements, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), Risk Management Framework (RMF), and system accreditation processes. Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or similar technologies. Experience administering virtualization technologies, storage systems (SAN/NAS), enterprise backup solutions, and disaster recovery processes. Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting scientific and engineering applications, compilers, and software licensing services.
